result.deliverySemantics: Persistent atomic order-ID admission prevents concurrent or repeated deliveries from creating another run. Completed append steps reuse receipts. Uncertain appends stop for review without resending. Partial writes require review of the original run, not redelivery with another ID. No cross-tab atomic transaction or eventual-completion guarantee.
